name: 55434 · Blaine, MN
findings: ZIP 55434 (Blaine) has 100 nonprofit organizations. 51 of them (51%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 42 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 55434 (Blaine) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.text: 10 hobby and sports organizations here list public events, compared with about 2 in similar places of this size.
